scope: standalone bass research decision; no model was downloaded or installed

primary_sources.fact: UMXHQ is trained on MUSDB18-HQ; README explicitly marks only UMXL weights CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so it does not establish a redistributable licence for the UMXHQ bass weight.
Official README identifies this DOI for UMXHQ weights; licence metadata must be captured from the resolved record before any delivery.
Core defaults: 4096 bins, stereo, hidden size 512, three-layer bidirectional LSTM; dense/BatchNorm/tanh/ReLU stages. Separator adds STFT/iSTFT and optional Wiener filtering.

verified.weight_redistribution: UNRESOLVED: MIT source permission does not licence a separately hosted UMXHQ state dict. Do not bundle, download at runtime, or convert UMXHQ weights until the pinned Zenodo weight record supplies an acceptable licence.
verified.artifact_format: The published loading path uses PyTorch .pth state dictionaries plus JSON model/separator configuration, not an ONNX delivery artifact.
verified.conversion: ONNX export is not a file conversion alone: export the instantiated core or Separator with fixed opset, shape policy, STFT/filterbank choice and output parity fixture. The repository says asteroid STFT can export to ONNX while torch STFT is faster; Wiener and inverse-STFT parity also require verification.
verified.runtime: The default bidirectional LSTM requires future frames, so it is offline rather than streaming/real-time. No ARMv7 benchmark or supported native runtime is published in these records.

inference.armv7_decision: Treat UMXHQ conversion as an offline desktop research-worker experiment, not a viable standalone norns/ARMv7 path, until an exported single-bass graph passes RAM, latency and numerical parity measurements on the target.
inference.actionable_native_path: Train and freeze a small causal mono bass-onset model directly on the independently scheduled corpus: log-mel frontend, depthwise-separable 1-D temporal convolutions or a small unidirectional GRU, sigmoid onset head, integer/TFLite or ONNX Runtime Mobile candidate. It avoids source separation, bidirectional recurrence and uncertain third-party weight redistribution. It still needs a licence for training data, export/operator audit, ARMv7 benchmark and held-out five-lane quality evidence.
inference.interim_path: For research only, use a separately licensed offline UMXHQ bass stem followed by a lightweight onset model; retain the separator as an optional worker profile and never describe it as standalone norns inference.

next_gate: Resolve and pin UMXHQ Zenodo licence, archive hash and model configuration before any weight acquisition.
Export core and full separator candidates separately; verify waveform/stem parity and operators with the target ARM runtime.
Benchmark 45-second buffers on ARMv7: cold/warm latency, peak RSS, model size and onset quality.
decision: Do not select UMXHQ for standalone delivery. Advance the small causal bass-onset model as the native research path; retain Open-Unmix only as a licence-blocked optional offline separation comparison.
